description: Ordered Java 25 and Azure Container Apps modernization tasks for Asset Manager. No live Azure provisioning, database changes/data migration, image publication, or deployment is included.

tasks.description: After the Java 8 baseline task passes, upgrade both modules to JDK 25 and Spring Boot 4.1.2, then run local regression tests. Addresses assessment issues: Spring Boot Version Has Reached the End of OSS Support; Spring Framework Version Has Reached the End of OSS Support; Java Version is not the latest LTS.
tasks.reason: The current Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 baseline is outdated and incompatible with the requested Azure Container Apps runtime target.
tasks.requirements: Run only after task 002 has added and passed the Java 8 baseline tests and frozen the pre-change web/worker behavior cases. Upgrade to non-EA JDK 25 and Spring Boot 4.1.2, including the Spring Framework 7.0.10+ and Jakarta API changes required by Boot 4. Resolve all libraries to public stable versions compatible with JDK 25 and Boot 4.1.2. Keep Maven Wrapper 3.9.9 unless compatibility evidence requires an approved change. Do not use Spring Cloud Azure: its official mapping documents Boot 4.0.x, not 4.1.x. Use direct Azure Java SDK clients managed by the selected stable Azure SDK BOM; confirm each SDK's Java 25 and Boot build compatibility before service migrations. After the upgrade, run the web and worker local regression tests on JDK 25 and compare behavior to the Java 8 baseline. Stop dependent tasks on any build, test, or compatibility failure; do not skip tests or change the Boot target without approval.

successCriteria.passBuild: Both web and worker build on JDK 25 with Spring Boot 4.1.2 and public stable, compatibility-verified dependencies.
successCriteria.passUnitTests: Java 8 baseline tests pass before upgrade; all focused web/worker regression tests pass on JDK 25 with behavior differences explained and approved.

tasks.description: Freeze the pre-migration web/worker behavior cases and mock strategy for post-migration service verification. Addresses assessment issues: none directly; this task records behavior for later verification.
tasks.reason: Mock-based verification needs a stable source-behavior specification without depending on live Azure resources.
tasks.requirements: Before any production-source or runtime change, capture the original Java 8 web and worker behavior, add or correct focused tests for the web UI, upload/list/view/delete, dev uploads without PostgreSQL metadata, non-dev metadata writes/reads, and asynchronous thumbnail processing, then run these tests on JDK 8. Record the selected JDK, Maven Wrapper version, exit code, and actual test count; any failure blocks task 001 and every dependent task. Produce the frozen test-case specification and an infra-decision table that selects mocks for PostgreSQL, Service Bus, and Blob Storage. Do not contact Azure or modify production application code. If the Java 8 tests or snapshot/specification fail, stop before the upgrade.

tasks.description: Move web and worker database connections to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with managed identity while preserving metadata behavior. Addresses assessment issue: Local JDBC Calls.
tasks.reason: Both modules currently use local PostgreSQL connection configuration; the target is Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
tasks.requirements: Update application database connectivity for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server using managed identity and TLS. Preserve the existing schema and metadata behavior: dev uploads do not write image metadata; non-dev uploads and thumbnail processing continue to persist and retrieve metadata. Separate PostgreSQL-internal application and schema-migration principals; do not confuse database grants with Azure RBAC. The application principal must have only required runtime data permissions. Provide a separate, reviewable database initialization procedure and disable production schema auto-update in favor of explicit initialization/validation. Do not create or alter any database, run DDL, migrate data, or store secrets.

successCriteria.passBuild: Web and worker compile with the new Flexible Server connection and managed-identity configuration.
successCriteria.passUnitTests: Focused unit tests prove the dev metadata omission and non-dev metadata write/read behavior; all module tests pass.

tasks.description: Replace RabbitMQ messaging with Azure Service Bus for the web producer and worker consumer using managed identity. Addresses assessment issue: Localhost Usage.
tasks.reason: The web and worker currently use RabbitMQ at localhost and need a managed Azure messaging service.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the image-processing producer and consumer to Azure Service Bus using direct Azure Java SDK clients and managed identity; do not add Spring Cloud Azure starters. Preserve the durable message contract and profile discriminator, manual success/failure settlement, duplicate safety, retry and dead-letter behavior, and graceful worker shutdown. First capture any broker-side RabbitMQ retry/dead-letter policy that is actually used; explicitly map and test its behavior rather than assuming it is declared in source. Use TLS and least-privilege sender/receiver roles scoped to the required Service Bus entity. Do not create a namespace/entity or use a live Azure service.

successCriteria.passBuild: Web and worker compile with the direct Service Bus SDK integration and no RabbitMQ runtime dependency.
successCriteria.passUnitTests: Producer/consumer tests cover success settlement, failures, duplicate delivery, retry/dead-letter mapping, and shutdown; all module tests pass.

tasks.description: Move dev local-file and non-dev S3 storage to private Azure Blob Storage while preserving profile-specific metadata and file/thumbnail behavior. Addresses assessment issue: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type.
tasks.reason: The application currently stores files locally in dev and in S3 outside dev; the target is private Blob storage for both paths.
tasks.requirements: Replace both the dev local-file and non-dev S3 storage implementations with private Azure Blob Storage using direct Azure Java SDK clients and managed identity. Preserve the logical dev/non-dev message discriminator and the dev rule that upload does not persist PostgreSQL metadata; preserve non-dev metadata writes/lookups, object listing, upload, application-mediated viewing, deletion, and asynchronous thumbnail creation/update. Keep the Blob container private, use TLS and container-scoped minimum data permissions, and do not use public URLs or long-lived SAS URLs. Include tests for allowed file types and safe object-key handling in coordination with the security task. Do not access AWS, copy S3 data, or create a Storage account/container.

successCriteria.passBuild: Web and worker compile with private Blob SDK storage for both profile paths.
successCriteria.passUnitTests: Focused tests cover dev metadata omission, non-dev metadata and thumbnail updates, list/view/delete behavior, safe file keys, and application-mediated private retrieval; all module tests pass.

tasks.description: Resolve verified dependency vulnerabilities and file-upload risks before packaging. Addresses assessment issues: the CVE findings listed in assessment_file.md for Logback, SnakeYAML, Thymeleaf, Jackson, Tomcat, Spring, RabbitMQ client, Netty, Spring Boot DevTools, AssertJ, Spring Data Commons, and PostgreSQL JDBC; CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type; CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory; CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password; CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials.
tasks.reason: The assessment reports multiple dependency CVEs and upload/path/credential risks that must be addressed before packaging.
tasks.requirements: Recheck the assessment-listed vulnerabilities against the upgraded resolved dependency tree and current public advisories; remediate applicable findings to the minimum supported patched versions without overriding the Boot dependency baseline unnecessarily. Review upload type/size validation and object/path key handling without weakening existing supported upload behavior. Remove credential-bearing configuration and ensure the Azure integrations use managed identity. Do not treat masked values or placeholders as proof of a real secret; report any verified secret separately and do not disclose it. If a fix requires an incompatible dependency or a change to the approved Java/Spring targets, stop and request approval. Run the vulnerability scan, build, and all unit tests; do not suppress findings or skip tests.

successCriteria.passBuild: Both modules build with the approved patched public dependencies.
successCriteria.passUnitTests: All tests pass and the final vulnerability report documents fixed, not-applicable, and unresolved findings.

tasks.description: Prepare Bicep and azd configuration for the Container Apps target and a separate database initialization procedure without provisioning. Addresses assessment issue: Local JDBC Calls.
tasks.reason: The participant needs reviewable deployment and database setup artifacts but this plan must not create or modify Azure resources.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep and azure.yaml for separate Linux web/worker Container Apps and the requested PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Service Bus, private Blob storage, managed identities, least-privilege role assignments, required network/TLS settings, and the future image registry. Keep subscription/resource identifiers, credentials, and secrets out of source; make location, naming, and sizing participant-reviewed parameters. Add a separate, reviewable infra/db initialization procedure and SQL/bootstrap artifacts that distinguish the PostgreSQL application principal from the schema-migration principal and grant only necessary permissions. Set provision to false. Validate templates offline only; do not run azd, log in, provision resources, change a database, transfer data, publish images, or deploy.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification. Addresses assessment issues: Local JDBC Calls and Localhost Usage are verified through migrated configuration; no live Azure resource is used.
tasks.reason: Mock-mode verification provides a post-migration check without creating resources or using live Azure services.
tasks.requirements: Use the frozen baseline test specification and mock dependencies for PostgreSQL, Service Bus, and Blob Storage. Verify web and worker behavior, profile-specific metadata semantics, upload/list/view/delete, thumbnail generation and metadata updates, message settlement/retry/dead-letter/duplicate behavior, and secretless managed-identity configuration. Do not connect to real Azure, create local cloud emulators unless separately approved, or claim a live-service integration result. This is a convergence gate and must wait for setupBaseline, the upgrade, every transform, security remediation, and Bicep/azd artifact preparation to pass.

tasks.description: Prepare Linux container images for the web and worker apps and build them with a local container engine only. Addresses assessment issue: No Dockerfile found.
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps requires container images for the separately hosted web and worker processes.
tasks.requirements: Create separate Dockerfiles for web and worker using stable JDK 25-compatible Linux runtime images, non-root execution, configurable runtime settings, and correct process/termination behavior. Use the local container engine for image builds; no remote build service, ACR Tasks, az acr build, image publication, or deployment is allowed. Confirm both images start in local smoke checks using mocks and that only the web image exposes the intended application port. Stop if the integration-test gate has not passed.
tasks.dockerfilePath: Dockerfile files for web and worker
